changed.before: Prediction — An expected observation under stated conditions.

changed.before: Fair comparison — A comparison that keeps other relevant conditions alike while testing a particular difference.
changed.after: Fair comparison — A comparison in which one difference is tested while other relevant conditions stay the same.

changed.before: Assumption — Something accepted for the moment without having checked it.
